test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 9 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence. Spices have exhibited numerous health benefits in preventing and treating a wide variety of diseases such as cancer, ageing, metabolic, neurological, cardiovascular and inflamatory diseases.
solution:
The correct answer is inflamatory.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of 'inflamatory' according to the English dictionary is '**inflammatory**'.
 
• The word 'inflammatory' means '**likely to excite strong feelings, esp. of anger**'.
 
 
• Example: *He thought his opponent’s remarks were unfair and inflammatory*.
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate answer is 'inflamatory'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the meaning of other options.

 
 
• neurological- relating to nerves.
 
• numerous- existing in large numbers; many.
 
• metabolic- Having to do with metabolism
